facts: The objects share a sulfonamide connection to different polycyclic aromatic fragments. Their complete connections are specified in the mapped graphs.
Source molecular studies considered environmental effects; in-vacuo and solution calculations have different physical references. No experimental conformer populations are provided.
measurement_definitions: Electronic energy, thermal correction and Gibbs free energy have distinct meanings. Population or equilibrium claims require a stated temperature, standard state, sampling basis and consistent free-energy definition.
A constrained configuration or scan point is not automatically a local minimum. Multiple starting structures may relax to the same physical endpoint.
A geometric contact or density-topology feature alone does not identify a unique causal interaction energy.
public_data_status: Available at task start; retrospective observations. No blind release mechanism is claimed.
